Declared a joint possession (condominium) of Britain and Egypt in January 1899 and in practice turned into a British colony; Egypt's parliament denounced the 1899 agreement on 15 Oct 1951 (BRE, Orlov).

Key events
  • Condominium Agreement 19 Jan 1899 (SFDAS_HCS2017 p.639)
  • Sennar dam completed 1925 to supply the Gezira Scheme (WB_TP120_1990 p.16)
  • Southern Policy (SFDAS_HCS2017 p.643)
  • Self-government 1953 (SFDAS_HCS2017 p.660)
Flag:

Joint flags, flown side by side.

Economy: MixedEDITORIAL
  • A.A. Abdussalam & F.S. Abusedra (Part II) (1985) The colonial economy: North Africa (General History of Africa VII, ch.17) UNESCO link [en] p.457

Rating basis: The Gezira scheme 'proved quite beneficial both to the British and to those people of the Sudan who were directly involved in it', but infrastructure was 'totally inadequate', industrialization was neglected, and the South was totally neglected economically.EDITORIAL

Main imports: Not yet researched

Capitals / sites: Khartoum

Culture

Southern Policy developed the South separately: Islamic proselytising banned, Christian missions encouraged, English in mission schools while Arabic became the language of the North (GHA VIII pp.148–150).

Economy

Kitchener's railway reached Khartoum, was linked to the Red Sea in 1905 (Port Sudan and Atbara founded), extended to Sennar and reached Kordofan by 1911; a Sennar–Port Sudan line opened in 1924. Egyptian long-staple cotton; the Gezira Scheme irrigated via the Sennar dam; Gash zone; 1929 Nile waters convention (GHA VIII).

الثقافة

طوّرت سياسة الجنوب الإقليمَ الجنوبي بمعزل: حُظر التبشير الإسلامي وشُجعت البعثات المسيحية، واعتمدت مدارس البعثات الإنجليزية بينما صارت العربية لغة الشمال.

الاقتصاد

بلغ خط سكة حديد كتشنر الخرطوم، ورُبط بالبحر الأحمر 1905 (تأسيس بورتسودان وعطبرة)، ومُدّ إلى سنار ثم بلغ كردفان بحلول 1911؛ وافتُتح خط سنار–بورتسودان 1924. والقطن المصري طويل التيلة؛ ومشروع الجزيرة المروي بخزان سنار؛ ومنطقة القاش؛ واتفاقية مياه النيل 1929.
